text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Phew...— 
I think this every year, but once it 
starts, it's over in the blink of an eye.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Ah... Air Groove-san.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Alv. ...Is it alright for you not to 
be surrounded by Rob Roy and the others? 
They seemed eager to talk about all sorts 
of things with you.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I've heard quite enough already... About 
how the concept hit Rob Roy-san right in 
the heart, and how Universe-san was 
delighted watching her—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...And about how Still-san devoured every 
single dessert 
we were serving. I've heard it enough... 
to the point of being sick of it.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Heh, is that so? ...Hm?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Groove-nee, Alv-senpai! 
So you were both here together.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
What's this, Dura, you as well? 
Weren't you talking with Kitasan and the 
others?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Yes, well... they did try to hold onto me. 
But tonight— 
just for tonight, I wanted to spend more 
time with the two of you.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...After all, this is a night of 
celebration, marking our victory at the 
summit.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed. Though I heard the fan poll 
rankings 
were exceptionally close—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
The ones who claimed the most votes were 
us. 
The winners of the contest... are us.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
As expected. It is all thanks to 
Groove-nee and Alv-senpai's great efforts.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I didn't really do anything special... It 
was mostly due to the hard work of you 
two.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hey now, you two, don't just be humble at 
a time like this. 
Honestly—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, quite right. ...The PR Committee just 
sent 
a collection of today's photos to the 
student council.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Here, take a look—at this valiant figure 
of Dura's. 
Hehe, this was when you put on that grand 
performance during the improvised play.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Just thinking back on it, it was 
magnificent. 
With your bold actions, you completely 
dominated the atmosphere of the room.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
In the end... I feel like that was the 
deciding factor for our victory.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not... Um, thank you very much. 
To be honest, I was desperate, so my 
memory of it is a bit hazy...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
And then... oh, I'm quite fond of this 
photo as well. 
Because it captured a truly wonderful 
expression of yours, Alv.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
This bewitching charm of yours is almost 
terrifying. 
No doubt countless fans were utterly 
captivated by it.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...You're giving me far too much credit. 
If you're going to say that, what about 
yourself—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
This one too. And this photo as well. 
Didn't the PR Committee's photographer get 
completely spellbound?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Well, when faced with Groove-nee like 
that... it was only inevitable, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Haha! What's this, are you two 
trying to get back at me? 
How cute of you!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
(Ah, truly—they are adorable juniors. 
Yet they've become so much more than just 
that now.)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You've both grown splendidly. —I'm proud 
of you, very proud.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
(I can feel that the ideals I demonstrated 
have been passed on. 
They are pulsing. Within them, without a 
doubt.)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: (...And that is precisely why—)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —I knew it. You were here, President.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, same to you. 
I had a feeling you would come by, Air 
Groove.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
And Brian... Hey, how long have you been 
sleeping here? 
Tell me you didn't just abandon the 
cleanup duties.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
You're loud the second you walk in the 
door... 
Frankly, I worked way too much today. I've 
done enough.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Though I believe the reason our theater 
cafe had to expand its stage 
was largely due to you—hehe, well, no 
matter.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to all your tireless efforts, the 
Holy Hoof Festival ended in massive 
success. 
The fans seemed thoroughly satisfied, but 
even more than that—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
All of the students were brimming with 
life. 
Even at the post-festival party, they were 
exchanging fond memories with bright 
smiles.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Besides, every last one of them hates 
losing. There are already those fired up, 
aiming to take victory in next year's 
booth contest.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. 
They were... yes.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: They looked happy. ...Very much so.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —Thank you, Air Groove, Brian.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Why so grandiose all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
A dramatic flair is simply in my nature, 
forgive me. 
Yet, it comes from the heart.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I am glad it is you two. 
I am glad to have you both on this student 
council.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, both now and forevermore, 
I can keep chasing that dream—to 'bring 
happiness to every Umamusume.'

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes, which is to say—my ambition is far 
from sated! 
I want to forge boldly ahead with you 
both, and build an ideal world.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hmph—if we are speaking of ambition, I am 
no different. 
We gained invaluable juniors. I saw our 
ideals embodied. That is precisely why—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I wish to continue demonstrating even 
greater ideals. 
And I am certain we can. ...So long as it 
is the three of us.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, is that so? 
...Indeed, Air Groove!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: And you? Brian.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hah? Like I care.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Me sticking around with you two—is just to 
kill time.
